# Tabitha Pratt

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001), [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Agnes  <sub>[v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v4 c19 P1](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** General servant at Hollowmere  <sub>[v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Tabitha is an old, unmarried woman who describes herself as lacking exceptional beauty, though she takes pride in her ears, which are of a pleasing shape and rest flat against her head.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v4 c17 P20](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0020), [v4 c24 P15](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

Tabitha is a stern, austere, and fiercely loyal woman who takes immense pride in her domestic duties, particularly her cooking and housecleaning. Though she holds strong, unyielding opinions on proper conduct, religion, and the upbringing of children, she possesses a deep, unselfish devotion to those under her care. She faces life's hardships with a practical, uncomplaining, and somewhat sardonic sense of humor.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v4 c8 P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 c8 P21](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0021), [v4 c14 P0](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0000), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000), [v4 c31 P2](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0002)_

- Fiercely loyal  <sub>[v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)</sub>
- Prideful homemaker  <sub>[v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v4 c21 P30](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0030)</sub>

## Abilities

- Exceptional cooking and baking  <sub>[v1 c21 P16](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0016), [v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- Care for the Carrow household and protect their children  <sub>[v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v5 c1 P6](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0006)</sub>

## History

Tabitha was initially hired as a general servant for the Carrow household at Hollowmere in Glen St. Agnes. Over the years, she managed the kitchen and household with rigorous efficiency, taking particular care during Nell's illness and childbirth. She practically raised Nell's son, Harcourt, developing a deep, maternal attachment to him. During Nell and Hugh's trip to Europe, she cared for Harcourt at her brother's home. Throughout her time at Hollowmere, she maintained a running rivalry with local gossips and defended the Carrow family vigorously.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000), [v5 c1 P2](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0002), [v5 c1 P5](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0005), [v5 c1 P6](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0006)_

## Background by volume

- Hailing from Glen St. Agnes, she never received a marriage proposal in her youth, a fact she attributes to predestination.  <sub>[v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v4 c22 P6](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0006), [v4 c22 P8](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0008)</sub>
- She had an uncle who was a poet and ended up as a vagrant.

> Mrs. Dr. dear, I brought him into this world every bit as much as you. The baby belongs to me every bit as much as he belongs to you.  <sub>[v5 c1 P6](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0006)</sub>

> Having a dog is pointless if you bark yourself.  <sub>[v4 c23 P0](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0000)</sub>

> I never could perceive that my bread rose with any less lightness when Grits held office than when they did not.  <sub>[v4 c35 P10](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0010)</sub>
